abort_policy: NONE. No per-field hang budget (FIELD-SWEEP-PROTOCOL 3c). Every value dispatched.

amendments.change: the two control_dim `dst` arms sweep 0..191 instead of 0..255
amendments.not_changed: every TARGET field is still swept densely over its entire encodable range, with no abort path and no hang budget
amendments.only_prior_capture: raw/pilot01 (a declared pilot, retained, never gated)
amendments.reason: pilot01 dispatched dst=192 on both reuse carriers and got 3/3 CMDBUF_ERROR with ErrorHang on each -- the dst[7:6]==0b11 wall EXP-0168 mapped exactly on frag_color_pack.dst. `dst` is a CONTROL here, not a field under test: its job is to fire once (it fires at dst=0), and sweeping 0xC0..0xFF would cost up to 256 device resets across two runs on a shared machine while manufacturing InnocentVictim contamination in the very target arms it supports. FIELD-SWEEP-PROTOCOL 3(c) forbids a hang budget on a field being CHARACTERISED; this is not that. The 0xC0 observation is reported as a finding and mapping that wall on simd_ballot.dst / simd_shuffle.dst is recorded as a named debt.

amendments.calibration: raw/prefreeze/calibration06_litmus.json (all 16 carriers OK, all four litmus oracles matched incl. the cross-threadgroup atomic)
changes: Gate A: run.py now re-reads the spliced archive FROM THE DISPATCHED FILE, records actual_bytes + program_sha256 + main_off, independently decodes the field from those bytes, and records outcome `ledger_mismatch` when requested != decoded or requested_bytes != actual_bytes.

Gate B / section 5 Phase 3: four MULTI-INVOCATION ORDERING LITMUS carriers (kernels/k_litmus.metal), 4 threadgroups x 2 simdgroups, cross-simdgroup threadgroup-memory exchange, a cross-threadgroup device atomic read back and checked, operand re-read after two barriers, THREE disjoint readback plans, PRE and POST sentinels, unique per-invocation codewords.
Section 6 provenance: each litmus is an _ld / _alu pair differing only in how the operand was produced.
Gate E: revision B runs forward AND reversed case order (--reverse).

Section 2: verdicts move to six independent axes with exact numerators and denominators; sem_checked == 0 can never yield hardware-run; a failed positive control yields carrier-undecidable; safe negative wording only.
